reasons: The bounded late-descendant case failed: stdout/stderr are empty although the benign child emits 32 bytes after 0.1s.
select timeout plus leader exit is not EOF; early breaks can drop data and leave owned descendants alive.
The added finally drain uses a new five-second deadline, instead of preserving the verification deadline.
Owned process group termination must remain possible after its leader exits; getpgid(leader) can fail then.
